meta.title: `dbg!` postfix snippet duplicates dereference
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#19764 (fix: Fix postfix snippets duplicating derefs)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2025-05-05 and 2025-05-12; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2025-05-12. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Postfix completion on a receiver that starts with a dereference ('*x') replaced only the part after the '*', so the '*' stayed in front of the inserted macro call: '*dbg!(*x)' dereferences twice (a type error that the native diagnostics do not report: i32 cannot be dereferenced). The case uses the specification probe edit_text_differs with the result the issue implies (the receiver replaced by dbg!(*x)).

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.source: issue body, 'code snippet to reproduce' block

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. Type '.dbg' after '*x' in 'let y = *x;' (line 2, character 14), request completion at the end of '.dbg' and accept the dbg postfix item. Reported: 'let y = *dbg!(*x);'. Probe (specification): the edited src/main.rs must equal the original with 'let y = dbg!(*x);' (the postfix item wraps the whole receiver *x).

expected.source: issue body (the result without the duplicated dereference: the receiver *x wrapped by dbg!)
